entry.summary:
Aotearoa Patient Safety Day is a commitment to consumers and healthcare workers that our health services strive to provide the best and safest care possible, every time.  

The way we listen to the consumer and their whānau, and demonstrate manaakitanga (kindness, respect and support) shapes everyone’s understanding of the issues to inform diagnosis. 

Listen to Carlton Irving, Director Māori Health and Consumer at Te Tāhū Hauora Health Quality & Safety Commission talk about the importance of listening and manaakitanga to inform diagnosis.

For more information visit: www.hqsc.govt.nz/AotearoaPatientSafetyDay2024
